plain_text:
Derry Conservation Commission 
Municipal Center, Third Floor Meeting Room 
14 Manning Street, Derry, NH 03038 
Agenda for November 16, 2026 7PM – 9PM 
 
 
 Advisory Notice: The Conservation Commission may, during any Public Meeting, vote to 
convene a Nonpublic Meeting in compliance with RSA 91 A:3, Section II. 
A Motion to do so will be made in Public Session and the Motion will cite the applicable 
subsection of the law. Further, compliance with RSA 91 A:3, Section I, the Conservation 
Commission may recess a Public Meeting for a period of time in order to excuse itself for the 
purpose of discussing matter not subject to the definition of the meeting.
